lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਦਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur dareeaau sadaa jal niramal miliaa duramat mail harai ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the River, from which the Pure Water is obtained forever; it washes away the filth and pollution of evil-mindedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਦੇਵ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur paaiai pooraa naavan pasoo paretahu dev karai ||2||
lines.translation: Finding the True Guru, the perfect cleansing bath is obtained, which transforms even beasts and ghosts into gods. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਲ ਹੀਅਲੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: rataa sach naam tal heeal so gur paramal kaheeai ||
lines.translation: He is said to be the Guru, with the scent of sandalwood, who is imbued with the True Name to the bottom of His Heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਸਉਰੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee vaas banaasapat saurai taas charan liv raheeai ||3||
lines.translation: By His Fragrance, the world of vegetation is perfumed. Lovingly focus yourself on His Feet. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jee praan upajahi guramukh siv ghar jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The life of the soul wells up for the Gurmukh; the Gurmukh goes to the House of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naanak sach samaaeeai guramukh nij pad paaeeai ||4||6||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, merges in the True One; the Gurmukh attains the exalted state of the self. ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee vidiaa veechaarai paR paR paavai maan ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, contemplate spiritual knowledge; read it and study it, and you shall be honored.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਾ ਮਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aapaa madhe aap paragaasiaa paaiaa a(n)mrit naam ||1||
lines.translation: Within the self, the self is revealed, when one is blessed with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: karataa too meraa jajamaan ||
lines.translation: O Creator Lord, You alone are my Benefactor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦਖਿਣਾ ਹਉ ਤੈ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik dakhinaa hau tai pahi maagau dehi aapanaa naam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I beg for only one blessing from You: please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tasakar dhaavat raakhe chookaa man abhimaan ||
lines.translation: The five wandering thieves are captured and held, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: disat bikaaree duramat bhaagee aisaa braham giaan ||2||
lines.translation: Visions of corruption, vice and evil-mindedness run away. Such is the spiritual wisdom of God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਚਾਵਲ ਦਇਆ ਕਣਕ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਪਾਤੀ ਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat sat chaaval daiaa kanak kar praapat paatee dhaan ||
lines.translation: Please bless me with the rice of truth and self-restraint, the wheat of compassion, and the leaf-plate of meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਘੀਉ ਕਰਿ ਐਸਾ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: doodh karam sa(n)tokh gheeu kar aisaa maa(n)gau daan ||3||
lines.translation: Bless me with the milk of good karma, and the clarified butter, the ghee, of compassion. Such are the gifts I beg of You, Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਊ ਲਵੇਰੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਛਰਾ ਖੀਰੁ ਪੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: khimaa dheeraj kar gaoo laveree sahaje bachharaa kheer peeai ||
lines.translation: Let forgiveness and patience be my milk-cows, and let the calf of my mind intuitively drink in this milk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਰਮ ਕਾ ਕਪੜਾ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: siphat saram kaa kapaRaa maa(n)gau har gun naanak ravat rahai ||4||7||
lines.translation: I beg for the clothes of modesty and the Lord's Praise; Nanak chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਾਵਤੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavat kinai na raakhiaa jaavat kiu raakhiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: No one can hold anyone back from coming; how could anyone hold anyone back from going?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਂ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis te hoaa soee par jaanai jaa(n) us hee maahi samaai ||1||
lines.translation: He alone thoroughly understands this, from whom all beings come; all are merged and immersed in Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂਹੈ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: toohai hai vaahu teree rajaai ||
lines.translation: Waaho! - You are Great, and Wondrous is Your Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਹੋਇਬਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karahi soee par hoibaa avar na karanaa jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever You do, surely comes to pass. Nothing else can happen. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਹਟ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਟਿੰਡ ਲਗਤ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਸਖਨੀ ਹੋਰ ਫੇਰ ਭਰੀਅਤ ਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise harahat kee maalaa ti(n)d lagat hai ik sakhanee hor pher bhareeat hai ||
lines.translation: The buckets on the chain of the Persian wheel rotate; one empties out to fill another.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਉਸ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taiso hee ihu khel khasam kaa jiu us kee vadiaaee ||2||
lines.translation: This is just like the Play of our Lord and Master; such is His Glorious Greatness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤੀ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਿ ਕੈ ਉਲਟੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: suratee kai maarag chal kai ulatee nadar pragaasee ||
lines.translation: Following the path of intuitive awareness, one turns away from the world, and one's vision is enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man veechaar dekh braham giaanee kaun girahee kaun udaasee ||3||
lines.translation: Contemplate this in your mind, and see, O spiritual teacher. Who is the householder, and who is the renunciate? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸਉਪਿ ਕੈ ਏਹੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kee aasaa tis hee saup kai ehu rahiaa nirabaan ||
lines.translation: Hope comes from the Lord; surrendering to Him, we remain in the state of nirvaanaa.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jis te hoaa soee kar maaniaa naanak girahee udaasee so paravaan ||4||8||
lines.translation: We come from Him; surrendering to Him, O Nanak, one is approved as a householder, and a renunciate. ||4||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: disat bikaaree ba(n)dhan baa(n)dhai hau tis kai bal jaaee ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to that one who binds in bondage his evil and corrupted gaze.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paap pu(n)n kee saar na jaanai bhoolaa phirai ajaaee ||1||
lines.translation: One who does not know the difference between vice and virtue wanders around uselessly. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bolahu sach naam karataar ||
lines.translation: Speak the True Name of the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: phun bahuR na aavan vaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Then, you shall never again have to come into this world. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: oochaa te phun neech karat hai neech karai sulataan ||
lines.translation: The Creator transforms the high into the low, and makes the lowly into kings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਗਿ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jinee jaan sujaaniaa jag te poore paravaan ||2||
lines.translation: Those who know the All-knowing Lord are approved and certified as perfect in this world. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਣ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭੂਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kau samajhaavan jaaeeai je ko bhoolaa hoee ||
lines.translation: If anyone is mistaken and fooled, you should go to instruct him.
